title: Bakken Bears celebrate BasketLigaen title
description: Bakken - Svendborg 82-63 Bakken Bears stormed past Svendborg to claim Ligaen title. Bakken dominated down low during the game scoring 54 of its points in the paint compared to Svendborg's 28. Bakken forced 20 Svendborg turnovers and outrebounded them 47-36 including 18 on the offensive glass. Bakken looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. The game was dominated by American players. Center Jacob Polakovich (208-2000, college: S.Indiana) fired a double-double by scoring 18 points and 13 rebounds for the winners. Forward Urald King (198-1990, college: SE Oklahoma) chipped in a double-double by scoring 10 points and 17 rebounds. Four Bakken players scored in double figures. Forward Isiah Small (202-1998, college: Texas St.) produced 17 points and 9 rebounds and guard Jemarl Baker Jr (195-1998, college: N.Mexico) added 14 points and 12 rebounds respectively for lost side.…
